text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I gave in to sweet temptation and ended 
up grabbing dessert, too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I ended up snacking while slacking off 
recently, and now my clothes feel tight, 
but still..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Sei-chan, are you getting lunch now 
too? Wanna eat together if you'd like~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sure~. Oh, if you'd like, do you want some 
of the dessert on the table?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, it's a thank-you gift for Spe-chan, 
since you're always doing so much for me♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you don't need to thank me, I 
should be the one thanking you... *drool*.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when I saw how delicious Spe-chan 
made it look while eating...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I think both my heart and my belly will be 
filled to the brim...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is, let's make it a great 
time from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? I can keep eating them from now on?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay, looking forward to eating you for 
years to come~. âWait, no, looking 
forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By eating lunch with Special Week for a 
while, Seiun Sky's diet ended up being a 
success.
